{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Man|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Man''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Warding]] 2 and {{MCW|Smite}} II. It is crafted from four [[Baked Golden Apple]]s, three lapis lazuli and a [[Silver Bullion]], and is the only book that stores a [[Warding]] enchantment.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/warding.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Man" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Man is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Warding 2 is one of the pack's [[intrinsic]] enchantments, which burns nearby undead mobs; the warding enchantments are exclusive with each other and with the other alloy intrinsics. The book shows Warding as its glyph (✟) rather than a name. Smite applies to weapons. The book has rare rarity.

== Trivia ==
* Unlike the other prayers, it is not addressed to a deity. Its texture file is named <code>blessing_warding</code>.
